title: The scalar model unit on every complex
statement: Let C be a site with an essentially small model in coefficient universe r, R and Rprime sheaves of commutative rings, phi:R to Rprime a ring map, and S its ScalarData [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. For every complex P of R-module sheaves, the derived adjunction unit on Q(P), followed by restriction of the universal model comparison epsilon and the exact restriction factorization, equals Q of the ordinary complex adjunction unit on P. No K-flatness of P is assumed.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: On a K-flat complex, apply transpose_model to the identity of its ordinary scalar extension. Simplify the two identity maps to obtain the unit equation.

Both sides are components of natural transformations on complexes. Choose a K-flat resolution P to P0 using lem-pc-kflat-resolution. Q of the resolution is invertible. Precompose with it, use naturality and the K-flat equation, and cancel to obtain the equation on P0.

theorem ScalarData.unit_model (S : ScalarData.{c, v, r} φ)
    (P₀ : CochainComplex (Mod.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ) :
    S.adjunction.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P₀) ≫
      (res φ).mapDerivedCategory.map (S.model.ε.app P₀) ≫
      (res φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        ((S.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P₀) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((S.ordinaryAdjunction.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app P₀)
